extraversion: stayed silent during the neighborhood gathering and chose a secluded seat
introduced several neighbors to one another and animated the gathering

repeatedly revisited an uncertain message and lost sleep imagining trouble

welcomed an unfamiliar performance and compared several unusual interpretations
